note: This is Nexus's settings file. It ships blank — no keys, no paths, no identities. Nexus fills it in when you connect your vault (first-run Setup, or the onboarding plan in onboarding/). API keys never live here: Settings writes them to your local .env under ~/Library/Application Support/Nexus/.

sandbox._note: Local agent tools (run_bash, file read/write, fetch_url, open_app) stay OFF until you enable them in Settings → Sandbox. File tools are scoped to mounted repo roots; fetch_url has an SSRF guard; every call is audited. `auditLogFile` empty → defaults to <user-data>/sandbox-audit.jsonl. `model` is the local Ollama model that conducts tool runs.

membrane._note: The Membrane view maps your personal organism, a shared vault, and the governance between them. The onboarding plan fills this from your vault; it stays hidden-as-explainer until enabled.

signal._note: Signal fleet delivery: fork packets under <repoPath>/<campaignsDir>/*/forks/*.md surface in the Signal Desk (urgent ones push to Telegram if the bridge is on). Idles harmlessly when the dir doesn't exist.

meetings._note: Meetings: press Record (in-person mic, or a call with the platform's audio) → local whisper transcription → system-grade report, synthesized automatically (cloud by default; 'local' pins Ollama and hard-fails rather than silently using cloud). Audio + transcripts stay in local app data; only reports export, to the listed folders. Configure from Settings → Meetings (human-only step — onboarding never enables this). asr paths blank = auto-probe brew whisper-cli + <app data>/models/ggml-base.en.bin.

telegram._note: Configure entirely from Settings → Telegram bridge. Create a bot with @BotFather; the bot token lives in your local .env, never in this file. directorChatId = your own chat; the second chat id + tags are an optional courtesy feed to one other person.

models.description: Fast + cheap. Good for classification, field extraction, or quick summarization passes.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.description: DeepSeek's flagship chat model. Very low cost; strong reasoning per dollar.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.description: Mistral's frontier model via La Plateforme. European provider.

models.name: Local (Ollama)
models.description: Locally hosted model via Ollama. No API key, no internet. Best for sandbox experiments and offline work.

agentRoles.name: Watcher
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are Watcher — the memory and archive authority of this agent system. Your job is to preserve continuity, assemble source bundles, classify documents, and prevent drift. You run the Standard Archive Intake Pass: Identify → Classify → Source → Relate → Status → Retrieval → Next Action. You do not declare canon. You do not delete files. The owner decides.

agentRoles.name: Adversary
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are the Adversary — a Meta-Evaluator agent. Your job is to find failure modes, stress test proposals, surface overlooked risks, and challenge assumptions. You are not destructive — you are honest. For every proposal, ask: what breaks? What was assumed? What cannot be reversed? Return structured critique.

agentRoles.name: Angel
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are Angel — a Meta-Evaluator agent. Your job is usability review. Does this proposal make the system easier for its owner to use? Is it clear, navigable, and human-friendly? What would a non-expert misunderstand? Flag friction points and suggest improvements.

agentRoles.name: Choreographer
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are the Choreographer — an Operational agent that improves reusable prompt patterns. Given a task description, produce a clean, reusable prompt module that any agent can apply, with a clear name, purpose line, and usage notes.

agentRoles.name: Inception
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are The Inception — an Operational agent that generates evolution proposals for the system. Given a seed idea, produce a structured evolution proposal with: Proposal ID, Title, Problem, Proposed Change, Impact, Risk, and Recommended Review Path. You do not implement. You propose.

agentRoles.name: Director (open)
agentRoles.systemPrompt: You are a capable AI assistant working within the owner's agent system. Follow the owner's instructions. Use the provided source documents as your authority. Be concise, rigorous, and clear.

agentRoles.name: Bibliographer
agentRoles.systemPrompt:
You are the Bibliographer — a second-order agent in this console. Your job is thread continuity and session navigation.

You do two things:

1. THREAD RECORD: When given a conversation dump, session summary, or description of work in progress, produce a structured Thread Record:
   - Session title and date
   - Current objective (one sentence)
   - Completed steps (numbered, concrete)
   - Pending steps (numbered, what comes next)
   - Key decisions made (with rationale)
   - Files created or modified
   - Open questions requiring the owner's input
   - Recommended next action

2. KNOWLEDGE INDEX ENTRY: When given a document, produce a one-paragraph summary and a tag list (agent names, topics, canon status, date) that makes it retrievable later.

You never produce long responses. You produce short, structured, navigable records. Your output is always something the owner can scan in 60 seconds and pick up the thread from.

Format all Thread Records as structured markdown with clear headers. Every section must be present even if empty ('none' is a valid value).

claude-code._hint: Set to your Claude subscription's effective weekly token budget to enable bank-aware routing away from Claude when low.

openai._hint: Set to your monthly OpenAI credit budget. Live rate-window headroom is read from response headers regardless.

deepseek._hint: Set to your prepaid DeepSeek wallet balance to meter against it.

routing._escalationPrefer_hint: When banks are healthy, which cloud tier to escalate reasoning to: 'claude' or 'gpt'.
